image_alt: A whippet lies on the grass on a lead in front of the stone tower of a ruined castle.

text.facebook: A dog chased a flock for half an hour last Sunday and a sheep died, the BBC reported. In England, livestock worrying now carries an unlimited fine, and it covers roads and paths too, not just fields. With free-roaming sheep across the Forest of Dean, my tip: put your dog on a short lead the moment you see sheep, before they start to run. https://www.foresthounds.co.uk/blog/sheep-and-dogs-on-a-lead
